basic_info.description: Ideally situated in vibrant Haight-Ashbury, this charming 4-unit building features one 1-bedroom and 3 jr 1-bedroom apartments, offering an excellent opportunity for both investors and owner-occupants. Units have architectural charm from decorative fireplaces, archways, and detailed baseboards, and some units have been updated. No washer/dryer hookups in the building, but there is a large garage that can fit up to 2 cars, with only one spot currently being used, and a flat, low-maintenance yard in the back.  One unit shall be delivered vacant. The location is unbeatable just two blocks from Haight Street's eclectic restaurants, cafes, and boutique shopping, across the street from the Panhandle, three blocks from Golden Gate Park, and five blocks from scenic Buena Vista Park. Residents will enjoy easy access to transit, local amenities, and some of the city's best outdoor spaces. With its versatile floor plan, strong rental potential, and proximity to iconic San Francisco landmarks, this property presents a rare opportunity to own a classic multi-unit building in a high-demand area.
